owner.workstream: Path of Exile 2 controls and enforcement research

applicability.tool_id: Private leagues; SSF; Azeron; native weapon sets
applicability.context: User asks whether a personally hosted server enables unrestricted mods and whether solo play on GGG servers changes macro permission

symptom: Private leagues, remotely hosted game clients and independent game servers are different capabilities

approach: Review current official developer policy, terms and private-league creation page
Check original director interview on offline support
Separate documented capability from absence found in public search
limitations: No server package or playable emulator downloaded or validated
The no-offline director statement is historical (November 2024); current store still requires broadband
Private-league page text describes optional modifiers but does not enumerate an authenticated current PoE2 modifier list
No direct controlled comparison of SSF and trade-league enforcement

sources.coverage: Director answer on offline support read
sources.observation: Director describes PoE2 as an online game requiring online play; no offline support

sources.coverage: Minimum and recommended network requirements read
sources.observation: Both require a broadband Internet connection

sources.coverage: Public description and fields read; no submission
sources.observation: Paid custom temporary league based on an existing league; capacity/duration controls and generic optional difficulty-modifier text

sources.coverage: Official PoE2 introduction and FAQ read
sources.observation: Private leagues use official character selection, trade/ladder and migration services; owner/officer powers are league administration
sources.limit: Launch-era absence of extra modifiers is not treated as current fact

sources.coverage: Independent app and macro requirements read
sources.observation: Manual invocation, fixed function and one game-interacting action; independent apps may be permitted subject to requirements; no solo/SSF/private-league exception stated

sources.revision: Current retrieved terms covering PoE1 and PoE2
sources.observation: Terms apply to both games; restrict unauthorized client/data modification, automation and reverse engineering

sources.coverage: Native skill weapon-set selection and innate-skill distinction read
sources.observation: Enabling a gem skill only on the intended equipped weapon set causes native swapping before skill use; innate weapon skills remain tied to their weapon
sources.limit: Not arbitrary inventory equipment swapping, gem replacement or crossbow load-and-fire automation

observation.claim: Official private leagues provide hosted league administration, not a downloadable independent server or arbitrary mod SDK. Published macro rules contain no solo exception.

inference.claim: No supported self-hosting/offline route or verified playable public emulator was established in this review. Installing only the game client on a personal remote machine would still use GGG services. Solo/SSF/private-league play does not establish different macro permission or hardware-ban protection.
inference.confidence: High for published rules and private-league distinction; search-limited for all possible unofficial emulators
alternatives: GGG could release a future hosting package or grant explicit written permission
Unverified projects or future developments may exist outside reviewed sources

supported_next_action.capability: Use native equipped I/II weapon-set skill selection; design manual single-action bindings and independent display helpers within published requirements
success_evidence: Native mechanism documented by Mark_GGG; no current local gameplay acceptance performed

permission.current_request_reference: Questions and source research only; no game launch, league purchase, server deployment or live macro test authorized by this turn

stop_conditions: Do not infer solo-mode detector exemption or machine safety
Do not treat private-league ownership as arbitrary code/mod permission
